topic: A traveler's flight is delayed, causing them to miss an important event
text: I stand by the vast, indifferent windows of the airport, watching the rain dance across the glass, a symphony played out in silver streaks. My flight, now a distant whisper on the horizon of time, has slipped away, leaving me here, adrift in the sea of faces. Every minute that ticks by, the weight of the missed event grows heavier, a stone in my chest. Yet, amidst the chaos and the low murmur of restless travelers, there’s an unexpected stillness within me. I find myself observing the world around me with a new clarity, each drop of rain a story waiting to be told. Perhaps, in this delay, there is more to be gained than lost.
